_doc: Additional BBB-tier hospital muni obligors (v2 expansion). Combine with bbb_tier_universe.json for full BBB universe.
_methodology: Web search via Becker's Hospital Review, Bond Buyer, Modern Healthcare, S&P/Moody's/Fitch press releases, EMMA. Researched 2024-2026 rating actions. Excludes higher-rated parents (Trinity, CommonSpirit, Ascension, Sutter, RWJBarnabas, etc.) and dormant/bankrupt issuers (Crozer, Heywood post-emergence, Prospect entities). Includes both core BBB-tier and fallen-angel sub-IG names where covenant pressure is the live signal.
_rating_definition: IG floor = Baa3 (Moody's) / BBB- (S&P/Fitch). Some sub-IG fallen-angels included where they were BBB within the last 24 months and covenant pressure is the active signal target.

disclosure_patterns_observed.1: EMMA filings: conduit issuer always cited at top; obligated group composition (Master Trust Indenture parties) listed in offering doc — critical for tripwire because covenant testing is at OG level not single-hospital level
disclosure_patterns_observed.2: Rating press releases typically lag actual material events by 1-3 quarters — material event notices on EMMA (covenant compliance certificates, DCOH disclosures, line-of-credit draws) are the leading indicators
disclosure_patterns_observed.3: BBB tier downgrades frequently cluster on: (a) IT/EHR conversion AR collection failures, (b) Medicaid supplemental funding cuts, (c) major capital project cost overruns, (d) CEO/CFO turnover, (e) line-of-credit fully drawn
disclosure_patterns_observed.4: Fallen-angel transition Baa3 -> Ba1 typically follows 2-3 negative outlook revisions over 12-24 months — predictable trajectory
disclosure_patterns_observed.5: Smaller standalones (Norman Regional, John Fitzgibbon, Magnolia Regional) often disclose actual covenant breach via Material Event Notice 4-6 months BEFORE the agency downgrade follows — EMMA filings are the alpha
disclosure_patterns_observed.6: Catholic and faith-based systems show distinctive pattern: extended deep sub-IG period (Caa1-B3) followed by slow turnaround with FEMA/one-time-grant reliance flagged in rating language
disclosure_patterns_observed.7: Split ratings (Moody's lower than S&P) are common at BBB tier — the binding covenant tripwire is the LOWER rating; must check obligor's MTI for which agency triggers
